**Top News**

- Iran targeted US forces in Kuwait with missile attacks, prompting American airstrikes on Iranian military sites and sirens over Kuwait City ([AP News](https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-irael-war-kuwait-strikes-88daa9f90b48baaa7beb18e35515c59d))
- OPEC+ is likely to raise July oil output targets despite Strait of Hormuz disruption, Reuters reports, as Asian imports of US crude surge but cannot offset losses ([Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/opec-likely-raise-july-oil-output-target-despite-hormuz-disruption-sources-say-2026-06-01/))
- Saudi Arabia strongly condemned Iran's repeated attacks on Kuwait, with the Foreign Ministry calling them "sinful," according to the ministry's Twitter account
- Kuwait authorities arrested three escaped inmates including two sentenced to death and a drug smuggler, according to Independent Arabia ([Independent Arabia](https://www.independentarabia.com/node/650268/))
- Bahrain banned citizens from traveling to Iran and Iraq due to ongoing security tensions, its Interior Ministry announced ([Sky News Arabia](https://news.google.-?oc=5))

- Kuwait Bourse closed higher, per Qatar News Agency ([Qatar News](https://ow.ly/Wybi50Z6C7r))

**Saudi Arabia**

- Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman offered condolences to former Yemeni President Abd Rabbuh Mansour Hadi's family following his death, according to the Saudi Press Agency
- King Salman promoted 327 members of the Public Prosecution at various judicial ranks, the Saudi Press Agency reported
- Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held a phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron to discuss bilateral cooperation and regional developments

**UAE**

- Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid announced the launch of the first batch of AI assistants for government procurement, taxes, and customer services during a federal government retreat in Abu Dhabi
- UAE leaders congratulated the President of El Salvador on his re-election, according to WAM news agency ([WAM](https://wam.ae/a/b1n6twr))

**Official Signals**

- Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan thanked President Trump for giving diplomacy a chance to reach an agreement to end the war and restore maritime navigation security in the Strait of Hormuz
- Qatar's Prime Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani and government spokesman Majed Al Ansari offered Eid Al-Adha greetings to the nation and Islamic world
